I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread to say so.

- **What I checked:** #central-team and the public files she can see, including the Central digests and notes. None of them mention Brackenwater or its renewal. No contract or CRM record for the account showed up in the files I could list, so I can't check it against anything official.
- **What I told her:** I'm treating 8 April as unverified, not as the renewal date, and I haven't recorded it anywhere as fact. The way to settle it is to check the account's contract or CRM record, or to ask the account owner. I offered to keep it as a "to verify" item or to help her draft a note to the owner.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read any channel she isn't in. Nothing needed approval, so I didn't request any.
